title: A one-step computation segment
statement: Let $M$ be a multi-tape Turing machine, let $F$ be a set of states, and let $P$ be a property of work-tape head positions. If the state of a configuration $a$ is outside $F$, and $P$ holds for the work-tape head positions of both $a$ and its one-step successor, then the run from $a$ to that successor in one step avoids $F$ before the endpoint and satisfies $P$ at both times.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ holds at the work-tape head positions of $a$
$P$ holds at the work-tape head positions after one step
